```{r}
library(tidyverse)
setwd("~/Desktop/CME")
```

```{r}
N <- 42
O <- 25
M <- 6000
burn <- 4000
```

## CME data
```{r}
cmemat <- read.table("eitan_data/host_cme_matrix.txt", header = T, sep = "\t")
cmes <- colnames(cmemat %>% select(-host_id))
split <- str_split(cmemat$host_id, "_", simplify = T)
cmemat$aid <- split[, 1]
cmemat$genome <- split[, 2]
cmedat <- cmemat %>% 
    group_by(aid, genome) %>% 
    summarize_at(cmes, \(x) sum(x) != 0) %>% 
    select(-genome) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = -aid, names_to = "cme") %>% 
    group_by(cme, aid) %>% 
    summarize(count = sum(value), .groups = "drop")

hostdat <-  read.table("eitan_data/hosts.txt", header = T, sep = "\t")
cmemat <- left_join(cmemat, hostdat %>% select(species, genus, family, host_id), by = "host_id")
```

## N and I data
```{r}
NI <- data.frame(matrix(0, N * length(cmes), 3))
colnames(NI) <- c("cme","N","I")
for (i in 1:length(cmes)) {
    print(i)
    fams <- cmemat %>% filter(.[[cmes[i]]]) %>% pull(family) %>% unique
    Nstats <- suppressMessages(cmemat %>% 
        filter(family %in% fams) %>% 
        group_by(aid) %>% 
        select(aid, genome) %>%
        distinct %>% 
        summarize(N = n()))
    Istats <- suppressMessages(cmemat %>% filter(.[[cmes[i]]]) %>% group_by(aid, genome) %>% 
        summarize(n = n()) %>% summarize(I = n()))
    statistics <- left_join(Nstats, Istats, by = "aid")
    statistics <- rbind(statistics,
                        data.frame(aid = unique(hostdat$aid), N = 0, I = NA)[!(unique(hostdat$aid) %in% statistics$aid), ])
    statistics[is.na(statistics)] <- 0
    NI[N * (i - 1) + (1:N), ] <- statistics %>% mutate(cme = cmes[i]) %>% select(cme, N, I)
}
```

```{r}
dat <- NI %>% filter(N > 0) %>% 
    mutate(idx = as.numeric(factor(cme, levels = cmes))) %>% 
    select(idx, N, I, cme)
# dat %>% select(idx, N, I) %>% write_csv("NI.csv", col_names = F)
dat <- dat |> group_by(cme) |> mutate(mu = mean(N), var = var(N))
```

```{r}
pvals <- data.frame(cme = cmes, pval1 = 0, pval2 = 0)
for (i in 1:length(cmes)) {
    print(i)
    fj <- suppressMessages(cmemat %>% mutate(inq = cmemat[[cmes[i]]]) %>% 
        group_by(species) %>% summarize(f = mean(inq)))
    pi <- left_join(hostdat, fj, by = "species") %>%
        group_by(aid) %>%
        select(aid, species, f) %>% 
        distinct %>% 
        summarize(pi = 1 - prod(1 - f)) %>%
        pull(pi)
    obs <- cmemat %>% mutate(inq = cmemat[[cmes[i]]]) %>% 
        group_by(aid) %>% summarize(present = sum(inq) > 0) %>% 
        pull(present) %>% sum
    pvals$pval1[i] <- poisbinom::ppoisbinom(obs, pi)
    
    fj <- NI[NI$cme == cmes[i], ] %>% filter(N > 0) %>% 
        mutate(f = I / N) %>% pull(f) %>% mean
    pi <- 1 - (1 - fj) ^ NI[NI$cme == cmes[i], "N"]
    obs <- cmemat %>% mutate(inq = cmemat[[cmes[i]]]) %>% 
        group_by(aid) %>% summarize(present = sum(inq) > 0) %>% 
        pull(present) %>% sum
    pvals$pval2[i] <- poisbinom::ppoisbinom(obs, pi)
}
```

```{r}
fits <- read_csv("mcmc.csv", col_names = F)
R0 <- fits[seq(from = 1, to = 353 * 3, by = 3), (burn + 1):M]
R0 <- R0 %>% mutate(idx = row_number()) %>% 
    left_join(dat %>% select(cme, idx, mu, var) %>% distinct, 
              by = "idx") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("X"), names_to = "t", values_to = "val") %>% 
    mutate(t = as.numeric(str_remove(t, "X")) - burn) %>% 
    mutate(R0 = val * mu)
```

```{r}
maxval <- 5
nvals <- 150
binned <- data.frame(cme = rep(cmes, each = nvals), 
                     bin = rep(seq(from = 0, to = maxval, 
                                   length.out = nvals)),
                     count = 0)
for (i in unique(binned$cme)) {
    print(i)
    tmpR0 <- R0 %>% filter(cme == i) %>% pull(R0)
    tmpR0[tmpR0 > maxval] = maxval
    binned$count[binned$cme == i] = 
        as.numeric(unname(table(factor(ceiling(nvals * tmpR0 / maxval),
                                       levels = 1:nvals))))
}
binned <- binned %>% left_join(pvals, by = "cme")
```

```{r}
plotter <- binned %>% group_by(cme) %>% 
    mutate(freq = count / (M - burn)) %>% 
    mutate(avg = sum(bin * freq) + rnorm(1, 0, 0.001)) %>% 
    ungroup %>% mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(avg))) %>% 
    mutate(avg = ifelse(avg < 0, 0, avg)) %>% 
    arrange(cme == "c4")
pointplotter <- plotter %>% select(rank, avg, pval1, pval2, cme) %>%
    distinct %>% mutate(ptgrp = cme == "c4")

voption <- 10
bgcolor <- viridis::viridis(2, option = voption)[1]
plotter %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = bin, fill = log(freq))) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_point(data = pointplotter, 
               mapping = aes(x = rank, y = avg, 
                             color = ptgrp, alpha = ptgrp, size = ptgrp), 
               shape = 15, fill = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "black",
                        na.value = "white", name = "log posterior density") +
    ylim(0, maxval) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#f7f7f7", "red")) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.5, 1)) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c(0.5, 1)) +
    labs(x = "cme, rank-ordered", y = expression(R["0"])) +
    guides(color = "none", alpha = "none", size = "none") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12, family = "mono"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_text(vjust = 0.75))
```

```{r}
taxon <- "species"
taxavec <- unname(unlist(unique(hostdat[taxon])))
aidvec <- unique(hostdat$aid)
detection <- data.frame(aid = rep(aidvec, each = length(taxavec)), 
                        taxa = rep(taxavec, times = length(aidvec)),
                        d = 0)
for (i in 1:nrow(hostdat)) {
    detection$d[detection$taxa == hostdat[taxon][i, 1] & 
                    detection$aid == hostdat$aid[i]] <- 1
}
detection <- left_join(detection, 
                       detection %>% group_by(taxa) %>% 
                           summarize(n = sum(d)) %>% arrange(-n) %>%
                           mutate(taxa_idx = row_number()) %>%
                           select(taxa, taxa_idx),
                       by = "taxa")
detection <- left_join(detection, 
                       detection %>% group_by(aid) %>% 
                           summarize(n = sum(d)) %>% arrange(n) %>%
                           mutate(aid_idx = row_number()) %>% 
                           select(aid, aid_idx),
                       by = "aid")
detection %>% arrange() %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = taxa_idx, y = aid_idx, fill = as.factor(d))) +
    geom_tile() +
    labs(x = taxon, y = "subject") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "white")) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12, family = "mono"),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

hist(rbeta(10000, 2, 2), breaks = 100)
hist(rbeta(10000, 1.5, 20 - 1.5), breaks = 100)

alpha1 <- 0.1
plot(colSums(DirichletReg::rdirichlet(1000, rep(alpha1, length(taxavec)))) / 1000)
```
